第38章 养魂术-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

这次的任务，依旧是抓捕怨灵，自从他升级到了二等鬼差之后，那些普通的游魂任务，地府已经不再给他派发了，除非地府缺人手了。

吴姜很快就找到了任务目标朱大庆，同样是一个被人害死的可怜人，只是比起吴姜第一个抓捕的怨灵，这个怨灵并没有想要害人，只是执念未销，这才一直滞留人间，没有去地府投胎。

朱大庆戴着一顶破旧的安全帽，一见到吴姜，就“噗通”一声跪了下来。

“鬼差大人，我是一个建筑工人，晚上加班的时候，因为出了工伤，黑心的包工头不想赔钱，就伙同他人，狠心的将我埋在了水泥路下面。到现在，警方还把我定义为失踪人员。大人，我只有一个请求，希望警方发现我的尸体，让我的家人获得应有的赔偿。”

吴姜看着跪在自己面前戴着安全帽的中年男人朱大庆，也是一副挠头的样子。

吴姜知道他说的是真的，任务信息已经佐证了他的话。

他为难的地方是，要是这个怨灵敢主动攻击他，他可以毫不犹豫的将男鬼擒拿，可对方这副老实巴交、苦苦哀求的模样，吴姜就开始坐蜡了。

他也不知道别的鬼差，碰到这种情况是怎么做的，琢磨了好一会儿，才开口说道：“我可以帮你报警，但是怎么让警方相信，我就不知道了。”

朱大庆瞬间喜出望外，连连磕头道谢：“足够了足够了，谢谢大人！我知道市局的刑侦大队的王磊队长，一直在追查我的案子，只要您将我埋藏的地方，告诉王队长就行了。”

之后，朱大庆带着吴姜，将自己埋尸的地点告诉了他，吴姜承诺他，明天就帮他找这个王队长，帮他完成这个心愿。

朱大庆连连感谢，又想给吴姜下跪，却被吴姜一把拦住了。

“我承诺你的事情肯定会做到，现在，你可以跟我去地府报到了。”吴姜说完，抬手召出了通往地府的阴阳通道。

可朱大庆还是有些不甘，他还没有见到凶手伏法，没有见到家人获得赔偿，不想就这么跟吴姜去地府，于是又对着吴姜连连的央求。

吴姜这次将脸一板，语气严肃起来：“朱大庆，你不要得寸进尺，本差能答应你帮你报案，已经是最好的结果了，再不进去，小心我直接动手了。”

朱大庆浑身一震，知道已经没有通融的余地了，这才唉声叹气的，让吴姜用勾魂索将他束缚住，踏进了阴阳通道。

This mission is still to capture the ghosts. Since he was upgraded to the second-class ghost mission, the underworld will no longer assign him ordinary ghost missions, unless the underworld is short of manpower.

Wu Jiang soon found the target of the mission, Zhu Daqing, who was also a poor man who was killed. However, compared to the first grudge Wu Jiang captured, this grudge did not want to harm anyone, but was obsessed with it, so he stayed in the world and did not go to the underworld to be reincarnated.

Zhu Daqing was wearing a worn-out safety helmet. As soon as he saw Wu Jiang, he knelt down with a pop.

"Master Gui Cha, I am a construction worker. When I was working overtime at night, I suffered a work-related injury. The evil contractor did not want to pay compensation, so he colluded with others and cruelly buried me under the cement road. To this day, the police still define me as a missing person. Sir, I only have one request. I hope the police will find my body and let my family get the compensation they deserve."

Wu Jiang looked at Zhu Daqing, a middle-aged man wearing a helmet kneeling in front of him, scratching his head.

Wu Jiang knew what he said was true, and the mission information had corroborated his words.

The dilemma for him was that if the evil spirit dared to attack him, he could capture the male ghost without hesitation, but Wu Jiang started to get upset when the other party looked so honest and pleading.

He didn't know what other ghosts would do in this situation. He thought about it for a while and then said, "I can call the police for you, but I don't know how to make the police believe it."

Zhu Daqing was instantly overjoyed and kowtowed his thanks: "That's enough, that's enough, thank you, sir! I know that Captain Wang Lei of the Municipal Bureau's Criminal Investigation Brigade has been pursuing my case. As long as you tell Captain Wang where I am buried, that's all."

Afterwards, Zhu Daqing took Wu Jiang and told him the place where his body was buried. Wu Jiang promised him that he would help him find Captain Wang tomorrow and help him fulfill his wish.

Zhu Daqing thanked Wu Jiang repeatedly and wanted to kneel down to Wu Jiang, but Wu Jiang stopped him.

"I will definitely fulfill my promise to you. Now, you can report to the underworld with me." After Wu Jiang finished speaking, he raised his hand to summon the yin and yang passage leading to the underworld.

But Zhu Daqing was still a little unwilling. He had not seen the murderer brought to justice and his family received compensation. He did not want to go to hell with Wu Jiang, so he begged Wu Jiang again and again.

Wu Jiang's face turned serious this time and his tone became serious: "Zhu Daqing, don't push yourself too far. The best result is that I can agree to help you report the case. If you don't go in, I'll take action directly."

Zhu Daqing was shocked, knowing that there was no room for accommodation, so he sighed and let Wu Jiang tie him up with the soul hook and stepped into the Yin and Yang passage.
